headline: D'Youville's winning run ends against a Great Midwest side
dek: D'Youville's run of wins ended against Ashland, a Great Midwest side with more defeats than wins this season. They now have seven wins, four draws and five defeats.
displaced_by: results night: Ashland, from outside the conference, end D'Youville's winning run
